question: Which of the following is another term for the average income of a country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Per capita income.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Per capita income is the** rational measurement of national income and the total population** of a country.
 
• It is the income supposedly earned by a single person in a country.
 
• This is also **termed as the average income** of a country
 
• it is an indicator of the living standard of a country.
